svg.title: Two panels. On the left, inside a box labeled P^5, the Klein quadric K drawn as a hyperboloid-like surface carrying a red alpha-plane, a green point and a blue beta-plane. On the right, inside a box labeled P^3, a red point, a green line and a blue plane. Dashed double arrows match the alpha-plane with the point, the point of K with the line, and the beta-plane with the plane.
